purpose: Traditional games as locally varied rules, social play, material equipment, teaching, and access to space.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name local rule set, player group, and place. Protect children in documentation; avoid presenting one version as universally correct.
